image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) on a textured, light-colored ground surface. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow spots and patches. Its skin appears wet and reflective. The head is broad with visible parotoid glands behind the eyes. Forelimbs and hindlimbs are visible, showing short, stout digits. The tail extends towards the upper left, partially out of focus. There is some text-like artifacting in the bottom right corner.
